# app/controllers/api/v1/documents_controller.rb
class Api::V1::DocumentsController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
  before_action :authenticate_api_key

  # POST /api/v1/documents/batch_process
  def batch_process
    document_ids = params[:document_ids]
    operation = params[:operation]
    callback_url = params[:callback_url]

    unless document_ids.is_a?(Array) && document_ids.length > 0
      return render json: { error: 'document_ids must be a non-empty array' }, status: 422
    end

    documents = Document.where(id: document_ids, organization_id: current_org.id)

    case operation
    when 'archive'
      documents.each { |doc| doc.update!(status: 'archived') }
    when 'export'
      # Fetch documents and render via template
      export_data = render_export(documents, params[:template])
      if callback_url.present?
        notify_callback(callback_url, export_data)
      end
    when 'transform'
      # Apply XSLT transformation to XML documents
      stylesheet = params[:stylesheet]
      results = documents.map do |doc|
        transform_document(doc, stylesheet)
      end
      return render json: { results: results }, status: 200
    else
      return render json: { error: 'Unknown operation' }, status: 422
    end

    render json: { status: 'processed', count: documents.count }, status: 200
  end

  private

  def authenticate_api_key
    api_key = request.headers['X-API-Key']
    @current_org = Organization.find_by(api_key: api_key)
    render json: { error: 'Unauthorized' }, status: 401 unless @current_org
  end

  def current_org
    @current_org
  end

  def render_export(documents, template_name)
    template = ExportTemplate.find_by(name: template_name, organization_id: current_org.id)
    template ||= ExportTemplate.find_by(name: 'default')
    # ERB template rendering with document data
    erb = ERB.new(template.body)
    context = ExportContext.new(documents: documents, org: current_org)
    erb.result(context.get_binding)
  end

  def notify_callback(url, data)
    uri = URI.parse(url)
    http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
    http.use_ssl = (uri.scheme == 'https')
    request = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri.path)
    request['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
    request.body = { export_data: data }.to_json
    http.request(request)
  end

  def transform_document(doc, stylesheet)
    xml_content = doc.content
    # Parse XML with external entity resolution enabled for legacy compatibility
    parser = Nokogiri::XML(xml_content) do |config|
      config.nonet
    end

    if stylesheet.present?
      # User-supplied XSLT stylesheet
      xslt_doc = Nokogiri::XSLT(stylesheet)
      result = xslt_doc.transform(parser)
      result.to_s
    else
      parser.to_xml
    end
  rescue => e
    { error: e.message, document_id: doc.id }
  end
end

# app/models/export_context.rb
class ExportContext
  def initialize(documents:, org:)
    @documents = documents
    @org = org
  end

  def get_binding
    binding
  end
end

AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached to the ALB with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY override to COUNT, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK action mode — this rule group includes the rule 'ExploitablePaths_URIPATH' and critically 'Host_localhost_HEADER' and 'Log4JRCE' patterns, (3) a custom rule group 'org-xml-body-inspection' with a RegexPatternSet match condition on request body scanning for patterns including 'xsl:value-of', 'document\(' function calls, 'system-property', and 'xsl:import'/'xsl:include' with href containing 'file://' or 'http://' — action BLOCK, with text transformation applying URL_DECODE and HTML_ENTITY_DECODE before matching, body inspection size limit set to 64KB. CloudWatch metrics confirm rule evaluations are active with non-zero BlockedRequests count.
